notes: Rejoined the Big East in 2020 for all sports except football (paid the American a ~$17M exit fee); FBS football independent since 2020 — no conference media share or bowl tie-ins, hard late-season scheduling, and a department that needs heavy university/state subsidy. Leadership (Maric, Benedict) and Gov. Ned Lamont have publicly pushed for P4 football membership; the Big 12 studied UConn during its 2023-24 expansion talk but its presidents declined; the Big Ten and ACC have shown no interest. Basketball is a national brand asset: two men's titles in three seasons plus 2026 runner-up; women's 12 titles. Dan Hurley turned down the Lakers in June 2024 and signed a long-term extension. Football coach Mora left for Pac-12 Colorado State after 2025; Jason Candle hired for 2026. State owns Rentschler Field and the XL Center (via CRDA) and has funded XL Center renovation; 2024 state budget cuts to UConn caused public fights between Maric and lawmakers. For the Big East, UConn is the top TV draw and its departure is the league's main existential risk. Event hooks: P4 invite (all-sports vs football-only), state bond package for football, Hurley NBA overture, Auriemma (b. 1954) retirement.
